evidence.description: The configuration accessor directly reads and writes persisted values through UserDefaults.standard.
reset directly changes user state through User.shared.
The notification-settings callback directly invokes a user-state update operation through User.shared.

candidates.explanation: Analytics directly obtains operational dependencies through UserDefaults.standard and User.shared rather than receiving them through an explicit, replaceable dependency boundary. These dependencies perform persistence and user-state updates.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: Analytics exposes a shared instance containing the mutable tracker property.
updateTrackerController directly replaces the tracker on Analytics.shared without synchronization.
The instance track method accesses tracker to submit events without an isolation boundary.

candidates.explanation: The mutable tracker instance property is reachable through the globally accessible Analytics.shared instance. The visible code replaces and accesses that property without actor isolation or synchronization.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation

evidence.description: The endpoint is selected from urlProvider properties and immediately force-unwrapped without a nil check or established non-nil invariant.

candidates.explanation: makeNetworkConfig force-unwraps the selected endpoint without a visible guarantee that either URL-provider endpoint is non-nil.
candidates.title: Unjustified Force Unwrapping
